definitions.gloss: to predict; to foresee; to foretell
definitions.explanation: To know or sense in advance that something will happen, especially natural disasters or future events.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{予知|よち}する⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{予知|よち}する⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that animals have the ability to foresee disasters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{予知|よち}すること⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: No one can completely foresee the future.

notes:
Often used in the context of natural disasters, especially earthquakes ({地震予知|じしんよち}). Implies knowing something before it happens through sensing or scientific means, not through deliberate calculation or analysis.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地震予知|じしんよち}: earthquake prediction
- {予知能力|よちのうりょく}: ability to foresee; precognition
- {予知|よち}できない: unpredictable
- {予知夢|よちゆめ}: prophetic dream

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{予測|よそく}する→予測する：19654_yosokusuru⟧: to predict; to forecast — based on data and analysis; more scientific and rational
- ⟦{予想|よそう}する→予想する：06064_yosousuru⟧: to expect; to anticipate — based on reasoning or guessing; more everyday
- ⟦{予言|よげん}する→予言する：25500_yogensuru⟧: to prophesy — often implies a supernatural or mystical prediction
- ⟦{予報|よほう}→予報：03668_yohou⟧: forecast — used for weather and similar systematic predictions

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {予知|よち}していませんでした
